notes.title: Changes of in-game sounds
notes.notes:
Hello Players! 👋

We’re glad to see you in another devlog from our 🎶 ASMR Kitchen! Today’s topic is of utmost importance for us. We’re aware that due to the name and theme of our game, the in-game sounds are extremely important for a satisfying gameplay. 👍 That’s why we’re working on multiple aspects of this part of the game. Before we take a look at the changes we’d like to announce that the next devlog will introduce some new content and mechanics you’ll be able to enjoy in the  👉ASMR Food Experience Prologue👈.

The first feature we’ve improved is none other than the depth of sounds. We’ve been working hard to make sure we deliver a quality experience allowing you to feel the direction and distance of different sounds. 🔥

Currently, most of the new sounds appear in the kitchen. 🍝 It’s one of the first games, where sounds have to be delivered so precisely and have such detailed characteristics, clearly distinguishable layers and features such as crunches not to mention the changes in the textures. This was a big challenge for our developers which they’ve faced head on! 💪 We can’t wait to hear your opinions on the new sounds. 🤩

We’ve started those changes with the sounds of chopping, frying, kneading and all the other sounds connected with cooking like pouring liquids. 🧴 We do hope that those changes will allow you to enjoy the gameplay more and to give you more of the ASMR vibe. 🎼

On top of that we’ve changed the 📻 radio sounds, from now it’s no longer omnipresent. It has a source in the dining hall and becomes a surround sound. This brings a significant change because the music played in your restaurants is mostly for the guests to enjoy. That’s why the further you go from the dining hall, the less audible the radio will be. 

[previewyoutube=A4AfH-U2bD0;full][/previewyoutube]

Please, take a look at the video providing some insight into the new sounds and make sure to let us know your thoughts on our discord 👇. If you have suggestions, ideas on this or any other part of the gameplay don’t hesitate to let us know! We’d also like to invite you to add this game to your wishlists on Steam 👇 so you won’t miss out on any further update.

See you soon,
ASMR Food Experience Team

notes.title: PLAYTEST - RELEASE DATE CHANGED
notes.notes:
Dear Community,

We have sent Steam keys to reviewers who started to share it on YouTube, Twitch, and other platforms. We have some positive responses but also a lot of feedback from them for which we are really grateful. 🙌

We decided the change the release date of the Playtest for December 2023. We just want to make sure that the Playtest is fully ready and you can enjoy it.

Thank you for your understanding - the entire team is working very hard to ensure that you can fully experience this first step in the ASMR Food Experience as best as possible. We can assure you that the Playtest version will be ready soon.

We will come back to you soon with more information - thank you. 🤝
ASMR Food Experience Team
